title: JmapRequestBuilder::add_call panics on duplicate call_id at runtime
description: JmapRequestBuilder::add_call panics (not Err) on duplicate call_id. When call IDs are generated dynamically (e.g. from UUIDs or counters), a collision is a runtime panic rather than a recoverable error. Callers in async contexts cannot catch panics cleanly. Changing to Result<Self, ClientError> later is a breaking API change. Before this API fossilizes, decide: is this truly a programmer-error-only invariant (always static string IDs), or does it need to be recoverable?
